name: freeze-and-is-frozen-test-c0f3b0e88b/frozen-int-array-modification-p.bal

reason: The asserted panic depends on obtaining a frozen array through a.cloneReadOnly(), an unsupported lang.value function and unsupported langlib method invocation. Supported list construction and indexed assignment do not make this whole case supported.
